decisions.decision: The Director will look into soliciting trained library staff from other libraries to fill in on a per diem basis when staff are absent.
Closure or delayed opening of the library during snow weather is at the Director's discretion, with the public notified via website, local radio and, when possible, the front door.
decisions.quote: it was determined that closure or delayed opening of the library will be at the director's discretion.

decisions.decision: Purchase of a barcode duplicator to bring previously barcoded items into compliance was deemed a worthwhile expense.
decisions.quote: this was deemed a worthwhile expense.

decisions.decision: The library will close on 12/23/10 with Union employees paid; Patty and Jen will be paid for 12/25 and 1/1 accordingly.
decisions.quote: lpl will be closed on that day and union employees will be paid.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three FY12 budget proposals prepared by Amy were reviewed: the Trustee Request, Level Funded, and Minimum State Aid; the Town Manager suggested a possible cap for the LPL.
budget_items.quote: the fy12 lpl trustee request ($391,550) reflects an increase in payroll and utility expenses due to proposed increased

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Level Funded option would require an accreditation waiver, a reduction of one staff member, and CWMRS funded from State Aid.
budget_items.quote: the fy12 level funded (329,791) would require a waiver to maintain accreditation, reduction of 1 staff member

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Minimum State Aid option would involve no change in staffing levels or opening hours and would maintain accreditation.
budget_items.quote: fy12 minimum state aid ($346,594 ) would involve no change in staffing levels and opening hours

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager had suggested at the Dept. heads meeting a possible budget cap for the LPL that would cover increased staffing but not increased opening hours.
budget_items.quote: the town manager had suggested at the dept. heads meeting a possible budget cap of

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Soliciting trained staff from other libraries to fill in on a per diem basis was discussed, at a stated hourly rate.
budget_items.quote: soliciting trained library staff from other libraries to fill in on a per diem basis ($11-12/per hour)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A barcode duplicator can be bought to bring previously barcoded items into compliance with the Mass. Library System autosort requirement; deemed worthwhile.
budget_items.quote: a barcode duplicator can be purchased for $600 -700

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Libraries not complying with the barcode placement requirement for the 7/1/2011 autosort change will be charged per item.
budget_items.quote: libraries that do not comply will be charged $0.04/item and the items may not be processed as quickly.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fines waived during the 5 Year Anniversary party/Fine Free Day.
Director sent a letter of intent to MBLC for an LSTA grant to fund the One Book One Town Reads program for FY12.
budget_items.quote: amy sent a letter of intent to mblc for a $7500

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Friends of LPL donated to the Endowment account in memory of Margaret Trocano.
budget_items.quote: a donation of $881.95 was received and deposited into the endowment account by the friends of lpl
